title: Free executor
script:
-- 0xNu51 Executor Mobile V2 - RC7 Remake by 0xNu51 2026 (HP Friendly)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- Password default

local PASSWORD = "RC7"

-- ScreenGui

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

ScreenGui.Name = "0xNu51ExecutorMobile"

ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui

ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Login Frame (Kecil HP)

local LoginFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

LoginFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 180)

LoginFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.5, -90)

LoginFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 20)

LoginFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

LoginFrame.Active = true

LoginFrame.Draggable = true

LoginFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local LoginCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

LoginCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

LoginCorner.Parent = LoginFrame

local LoginGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")

LoginGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{

    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)),

    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 50))

}

LoginGradient.Rotation = 45

LoginGradient.Parent = LoginFrame

local LoginTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

LoginTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)

LoginTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1

LoginTitle.Text = "0xNu51 EXEC"

LoginTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)

LoginTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Code

LoginTitle.TextSize = 24

LoginTitle.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5

LoginTitle.Parent = LoginFrame

local LoginPass = Instance.new("TextBox")

LoginPass.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 35)

LoginPass.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.35, 0)

LoginPass.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)

LoginPass.PlaceholderText = "Password..."

LoginPass.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)

LoginPass.Font = Enum.Font.Code

LoginPass.TextSize = 16

LoginPass.Parent = LoginFrame

local LoginCornerPass = Instance.new("UICorner")

LoginCornerPass.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

LoginCornerPass.Parent = LoginPass

local LoginBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

LoginBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 45)

LoginBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.65, 0)

LoginBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 80)

LoginBtn.Text = "LOGIN"

LoginBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)

LoginBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

LoginBtn.TextSize = 18

LoginBtn.Parent = LoginFrame

local LoginBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

LoginBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

LoginBtnCorner.Parent = LoginBtn

-- Main Frame (Kecil HP)

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 420)

MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -210)

MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 15, 5)

MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

MainFrame.Visible = false

MainFrame.Active = true

MainFrame.Draggable = true

MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 15)

MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

local MainGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")

MainGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{

    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 50)),

    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 50, 20))

}

MainGradient.Rotation = 90

MainGradient.Parent = MainFrame

local MainTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

MainTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)

MainTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1

MainTitle.Text = "0xNu51 EXEC - Mobile"

MainTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)

MainTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Code

MainTitle.TextSize = 20

MainTitle.Parent = MainFrame

local ScriptBox = Instance.new("TextBox")

ScriptBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0.68, 0)

ScriptBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0.14, 0)

ScriptBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 30, 20)

ScriptBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0.8, 1, 0.8)

ScriptBox.PlaceholderText = "Paste Lua script..."

ScriptBox.Text = ""

ScriptBox.MultiLine = true

ScriptBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

ScriptBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

ScriptBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false

ScriptBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code

ScriptBox.TextSize = 14  -- Kecil buat HP

ScriptBox.Parent = MainFrame

local ScriptCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

ScriptCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

ScriptCorner.Parent = ScriptBox

-- Buttons (Compact HP)

local ExecuteBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

ExecuteBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 45)

ExecuteBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0.84, 0)

ExecuteBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)

ExecuteBtn.Text = "EXEC"

ExecuteBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)

ExecuteBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

ExecuteBtn.TextSize = 18

ExecuteBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local ExecCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

ExecCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

ExecCorner.Parent = ExecuteBtn

local ClearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

ClearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 45)

ClearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.84, 0)

ClearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0)

ClearBtn.Text = "CLEAR"

ClearBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)

ClearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

ClearBtn.TextSize = 18

ClearBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local ClearCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

ClearCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

ClearCorner.Parent = ClearBtn

local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 45)

CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.675, 0, 0.84, 0)

CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)

CloseBtn.Text = "CLOSE"

CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

CloseBtn.TextSize = 18

CloseBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

CloseCorner.Parent = CloseBtn

-- Logic

LoginBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    if LoginPass.Text == PASSWORD then

        LoginFrame.Visible = false

        MainFrame.Visible = true

        print("0xNu51 Mobile: Access granted!")

    else

        LoginPass.Text = ""

        LoginPass.PlaceholderText = "Wrong! Try again..."

    end

end)

ExecuteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    local code = ScriptBox.Text

    if code == "" then return end

    local success, err = pcall(function() loadstring(code)() end)

    if not success then warn("0xNu51 Error: " .. tostring(err)) end

end)

ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ScriptBox.Text = "" end)

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)

-- Close Login X

local LoginClose = Instance.new("TextButton")

LoginClose.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)

LoginClose.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 4)

LoginClose.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)

LoginClose.Text = "X"

LoginClose.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

LoginClose.Parent = LoginFrame

local LCloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

LCloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

LCloseCorner.Parent = LoginClose

LoginClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)

print("0xNu51 Mobile Executor Loaded! Password: 0xNu51 (HP Optimized)")
